// why not ../tsconfig.base.json: The mappings are AssemblyScript, not TypeScript: they use i32/u64/f64, changetype<T>,
and the graph-ts globals. The repo's base config targets ES2022 TypeScript and would
reject all of it. Type checking for this package is `graph codegen && graph build`,
which compiles the mappings to wasm through asc; this file exists for editor support.
